summary: Caribou Biosciences filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose press releases announcing clinical trial data from its ANTLER phase 1 trial of vispacabtagene regedleucel for B-NHL and its CaMMouflage phase 1 trial of CB-011 for multiple myeloma. The data will be presented at an upcoming medical conference. The filing is purely a routine clinical update through Regulation FD and Other Events; it does not involve any merger, acquisition, restructuring, tender offer, or other special situation. No deal terms or strategic actions are disclosed.
